items.t: No City of Mission neighbourhood page or plan naming "Steelhead" was found pass, so its status as a City-recognised neighbourhood name (as opposed to a board/community name) is not verified.

Boundaries: no official boundary for the sub-area was found — not verified as an official boundary. Treat this as feed scope, never as a boundary citation. One feed listing is a small lot on Silverdale Avenue described in its own text as being in the Silverdale lands yet labelled "Steelhead" by the feed, so the feed scope and the neighbouring Silverdale area overlap at the south edge; where the board draws the Steelhead/Silverdale line is not confirmed.

Nearby areas: Stave Falls to the northeast (a separate sub-area in the same SnapStats table), Silverdale to the south and southwest, Mission West and the urban Mission core to the southeast, and Hayward Lake / Ruskin across the Stave River side to the south.

A zero row in a small rural sub-area says nothing about values or demand. Mission community figures that month (sub-area medians are not published): detached median $814,000, $353/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 29 days on market; Condos & Townhomes median $430,000, $368/sq ft, 95% sale-to-list, 61 days on market.

Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere — there is no verified condo stock in Steelhead at all. The sub-area's published attached shelf was empty in September 2026 and no named condo building or townhome complex was confirmed on any source checked; the housing is rural acreage parcels with detached houses and manufactured homes on owned land, plus bare land.

Schools: Mission is School District 75 (Mission Public Schools), structured elementary K–6, middle 7–9 and secondary 10–12; the two middle schools are Hatzic Middle School and École Heritage Park Middle School, and the secondary school is Mission Senior Secondary, 32939 7th Avenue. The nearest confirmed elementaries are Stave Falls Elementary (K–6), 30204 Brackley Avenue, in Stave Falls to the northeast, and Silverdale Elementary (K–6), 29715 Donatelli Avenue, in Silverdale to the south. SD75 catchments are set under the district's Catchment Areas policy, and no document opened states the catchment schools for a Steelhead address — address-level catchments are not verified.
The rail link for the city is the West Coast Express at Mission City Station, with weekday trains between Mission City and Waterfront (downtown Vancouver).
Main roads: access runs from Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) north through Silverdale Avenue / Stave Lake Street and Steelhead Road to the Campbell, Sabo and Cardinal Street pockets.

Recreation anchor: BC Hydro's Hayward Lake recreation area, near Mission on the Stave River system — the reservoir is an active hydroelectric facility and a popular recreation area, with the Stave Lake boat launch and Ruskin Dam recreation area also BC Hydro sites; the City of Mission restricts parking on city roads leading to Hayward Lake at busy times.

items.t: Secondary dwellings: a Mission secondary suite is a self-contained living space inside a single family home forming part of the same real estate entity; a suite is not a coach home or garden cottage (those are detached secondary dwellings); suites are not permitted in townhouses or rowhomes; all suites must be registered with the City, new suites go through the building permit process, and an annual secondary suite fee of $63 plus utility fees applies.

Wells, septic and ALR: the feed's own listings show the area's servicing pattern — drilled wells, septic systems and propane heat on acreage parcels. Wells are recorded in the provincial GWELLS database, and onsite sewerage must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation, including the 30 m setback from a well unless professional advice is obtained. ALR status is per-parcel — check the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)), which is one structural reason no ALR parcel here can become condo stock.

Manufactured homes and pad rent: the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act limits pad-rent increases in manufactured home parks (2026: 2.3% plus a proportional amount; 2027: 2.2% plus a proportional amount). Steelhead's manufactured homes in the feed are on owned land, not park pads, so the MHPTA regime does not apply to them — a buyer who wants park-tenure product is looking at a different sub-area and a different tenure entirely.

No City of Mission neighbourhood page or plan naming Steelhead was found — searches run under only the board name miss City documents filed under the rural zone framework (RU80 / RU36 / RU16) and the Stave Falls / Silverdale community names.

The feed quietly crosses into Silverdale. One of the eight feed listings is a Silverdale Avenue lot its own text places in the Silverdale lands, yet the feed labels it Steelhead — the board line between the two sub-areas at the south edge is not confirmed, and a buyer comparing "Steelhead" listings may be looking at two different school catchments and servicing areas.

Stave Falls is inside the City of Mission — the neighbouring sub-area to the northeast is city land on the same rural rules, not a separate jurisdiction, even though it reads like a standalone village.

Hydro shaped this valley before the houses did. Construction of the Stave Falls Dam and Powerhouse began in 1909 and was completed by January 1, 1912 (BC Hydro); Hayward Lake is an active hydroelectric reservoir first and a recreation area second, and the City restricts parking on the roads leading to it at busy times — summer access pressure is part of the ownership picture.

The two nearest elementary schools sit in two different communities. Stave Falls Elementary is northeast in Stave Falls and Silverdale Elementary is south in Silverdale, and SD75 catchments are set by district policy — a Steelhead address cannot be school-matched by community name alone.
Mission's current OCP is newer than most listing copy. Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026 was adopted June 1, 2026, and material citing the predecessor bylaw is a bylaw out of date.

The hospital is in town, not out here. Mission Memorial Hospital, 7324 Hurd Street, provides 24/7 emergency stabilization and care, general medicine and ambulatory care (Fraser Health) — every service run from a Steelhead acreage is a drive to the urban core southeast.

faq.a: Steelhead is a rural acreage community in the City of Mission, on the Stave Lake / Steelhead Road side west of the urban core. SnapStats lists it as an FVREB sub-area under Mission, with larger rural lots and forested settings and access toward Stave Falls and Hayward Lake, distinct from the Stave Falls waterfront market (SnapStats, September 2026)

An in-house secondary suite is permitted inside a single family home if it is registered with the City (new suites need a building permit; a $63 annual suite fee plus utility fees applies), but a detached coach home or garden cottage is a secondary detached dwelling — on rural lots that generally requires the secondary-dwelling ("s") variant of the parcel's zone, which City material shows owners obtaining by rezoning (e.g., RU16 to RU16s).
faq.q: Can a Steelhead acreage have a suite or a second dwelling?

faq.a: BC Hydro's Hayward Lake recreation area — a hydroelectric reservoir and popular recreation area near Mission, with the Stave Lake boat launch and Ruskin Dam recreation area nearby — plus the Stave Falls Powerhouse visitor facilities; the City of Mission restricts parking on the roads leading to Hayward Lake at busy times.
